method: targeted source-English semantic review in adjacent verse context

corrections.reason: Алайып describes eyes staring wide, not literal loss of eyes.
Салактап describes dangling or hanging loose.
Кулап кете таштады describes the imminent fall from Tookyzyl in the preceding row.

corrections.old: A lion girl in one shot
corrections.en: At one spear thrust from the lion-hearted girl,
corrections.reason: Бир сайганда is one thrust in this spear-fight context.
Кудай сактай көргүн is a plea for protection.

corrections.en: His limbs went slack and twisted,
corrections.reason: Муун бошоп буралып describes the wounded warrior's weakening body.
Көз байланып тунарып describes darkening sight, not an actual blindfold.

corrections.en: Now he suffered all the more:
corrections.reason: Азапты артык тартты expresses greater suffering, not preference.
Арман is lament or grievance in this speech, not a dream.

corrections.old: Make the moon and the universe,
corrections.en: Having made the whole world obey,
corrections.reason: Ай-аалам denotes the world at large; буй кылып denotes commanding it.

corrections.old: I made a song about Sarybay,
corrections.en: I made Sarybay a lion of a man,
corrections.reason: Шер is the heroic lion epithet, not a song.

corrections.old: When my father chased the blue sky,
corrections.en: When my father chased the gray wolf,
corrections.reason: Көкжал means gray wolf and can serve as a heroic epithet; it does not mean sky.

corrections.old: Cut the wire and make a horse.
corrections.en: Cutting a twig to make a toy horse,
corrections.reason: Чыбык is a twig or switch, used as a child's make-believe horse here.

corrections.en: Striking the horse's rump with a whip,
corrections.reason: Ат арты is the horse's rear, continuing the childhood play image.

corrections.old: This did not happen to the girl.
corrections.en: No girl had ever done such a thing.
corrections.reason: Кыздан мындай болбоду compares this girl's exceptional feat with others.

corrections.en: A woman in name, a mighty wrestler,
corrections.reason: Аты катын, эр балбан contrasts her being called a woman with heroic strength.

corrections.en: A foe nursing a grudge came forth,
corrections.reason: Кекенишкен жоо means a hostile, resentful enemy.
Жекеге келип describes coming to a duel.

corrections.en: He closed in and thrust his spear once.
corrections.reason: Жетишип means reaching or closing in; бир сайган is one thrust, not seventy.
